title: Principal资管Seema Shah预计美联储年内再加息一次
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Do you think this market is now baking in one more rate hike, I guess, for the year?
segments.zh: 你觉得市场现在是否预期年内还会再加息一次？

segments.en: Yeah. I think that the... Because of the timing of the midterms, October is a tough one.
segments.zh: 是的。我认为……由于中期选举的时间安排，十月比较棘手。

segments.en: And suddenly, unless there's a really atrocious inflation report, October is likely to be a hold.
segments.zh: 除非出现非常糟糕的通胀报告，否则十月很可能按兵不动。

segments.en: Which takes you to December, so that's what your second hike. And the question mark after that is in 2027 what happens.
segments.zh: 这就到了十二月，所以那是第二次加息。之后2027年会发生什么还是个问号。

segments.en: You can see there's a number of forecasts out there who suggest no change to the next year, potentially even some cuts.
segments.zh: 你可以看到，有不少预测认为明年不会变化，甚至可能有一些降息。

segments.en: Study from our side because we're anticipating inflation to start actually coming down over the next couple of months and then a really big drop in February as you see some of the seasonality
segments.zh: 我们这边研究显示，我们预计通胀实际上会在未来几个月开始下降，然后在二月出现大幅下降，因为一些季节性因素消退。

segments.en: factors falling off. We actually think we're going to see one more in December and then likely to be that's it.
segments.zh: 我们实际上认为十二月还会再加一次，然后很可能就到此为止了。
